case: JWST GO-3290 MOCSS HUDF, unexplained 16004-A emission line

hypothesis_line_windows_angstrom.warning: Published non-detection at 15864A cannot be treated as an injected-source-calibrated 3sigma constraint at 15850.8A.

provisional_rate_contrast_not_snr.unit: local matched-filter residual over uncalibrated detector-column MAD; NOT Gaussian sigma
provisional_rate_contrast_not_snr.smooth_detector_background_robustness: 31/41/61-pixel median subtraction along dispersion; major instrumental gradient in August
provisional_rate_contrast_not_snr.positive_interpretation: Pixel-space feature repeats near the WCS-predicted line in A, B and D under several high-pass scales.
provisional_rate_contrast_not_snr.negative_interpretation: The data do not justify a 3-sigma detection, upper limit, Pa-gamma claim, transient variability or source identity.

sky_field.why_not_p_value: Multiple correlated spatial cells; source chosen from prior publication; detector high-pass and background unvalidated

guarded_training_cases.question: Does an emission-like 16004A spot repeating in raw WCS coadds prove the source is a TDE or type IIn SN?
guarded_training_cases.answer: No. It is a reproducibility hint subject to detector flat/background and selection bias. The source type and variability remain unresolved.

guarded_training_cases.question: Did an independent analysis test the oxygen companion at 15850.8A?
guarded_training_cases.answer: Yes: geometry-projected raw-rate contrasts and field controls were tested. No science-grade calibrated flux upper limit was derived.

guarded_training_cases.question: Does weak Pa-gamma contrast in B/C/D confirm redshifted Pa-beta?
guarded_training_cases.answer: No. Controls are empirical and residuals are not independent significances; A is negative. Perform complete stage-2 reduction and injection limits.

guarded_training_cases.question: Does the 3-arcsecond sky map establish a gas filament or directional beam?
guarded_training_cases.answer: No. It only provides provisional spatial contrasts; there is no repeatable same-wavelength signal tracing the neighboring galaxy centers, and no measured physical length.

guarded_training_cases.question: What would make the AGN-illuminated-cloud hypothesis testable?
guarded_training_cases.answer: NIRSpec IFU calibrated 16004A and companion line maps, velocity field, source and JADES neighbor alignment, with a mosaic if emission extends beyond the 3x3 arcsecond field.

stage2_three_line_followup.required_pipeline_reference: jwst 1.19.1, CRDS jwst_1413.pmap, MOCSS-specific open-shutter calibration
stage2_three_line_followup.science_rule: Source class and distance cannot be promoted from predicted lines, high-pass RATE contrasts or synthetic fitter self-tests. Require pinned real x1d inputs with calibrated independent spectral extraction and injection-recovery.
